task_description: Phase 2 Sub-Phase 1: Implement a working HTTP web server for the vek language. This includes a native module/stdlib system, an epoll-based event loop, HTTP/1.1 parser and server with trie-based routing, and core stdlib packages (log, env, json, time, crypto, path, uuid, kv, cache). The end result is a vek program that can define route handlers and serve HTTP requests.

verification.summary: All tests pass: 106 unit tests (compiler 20, event_loop 7, gc 6, lexer 31, object 18, value 24) + 9 integration tests + 7 HTTP server tests + 20 web app tests. Build compiles cleanly. Tests exercise real code paths including network I/O, HTTP parsing, route matching with params, JSON encode/decode, KV state persistence, and keep-alive connections.

issues_fixed: Timer EpollData leak on cancel - added epoll_data field to Timer struct, freed in cancel_timer and destroy
Use-after-free on EPOLLIN+EPOLLOUT dispatch - handle_read returns closed flag, dispatch breaks before EPOLLOUT
Keep-alive timeout not renewed - re-arm timer after successful request parse in both on_data_vek and on_data
Use-after-free in two-part response write - combined header+body into single buffer in http_response_send to prevent on_write_done from firing between writes

HttpConnState leak on timeout and peer disconnect - added on_close callback to Connection struct called from event_loop_conn_close, registered cleanup in both accept handlers, freed state in timeout handlers before close
